fix(release): drop oxidation extra; PyPI rejects direct VCS deps

The 2026.5.18.0 build couldn't upload to PyPI — the [oxidation] extra
in pyproject.toml referenced m3-core-rs via a git+https URL, which
PyPI policy forbids in published distributions (400 Bad Request,
"Can't have direct dependency").

Removed the extra from pyproject.toml. m3-core-rs is now installed
manually until it ships its own wheels to PyPI:

  pip install "m3-core-rs @ git+https://github.com/skynetcmd/\

other non-root locator silently fell back to "add a slide under the

invalid-path diagnostic. Slides hang off the presentation root only.

fix(daemon): SIGTERM/SIGINT/atexit handlers flush ring buffer before exit (closes #1593) (#1612)

Without these handlers, any events queued in the LocalStore ring buffer
but not yet flushed by the 2s flusher tick are dropped on graceful
shutdown — `launchctl bootout`, `systemctl stop`, `kill <pid>`, Ctrl+C,
or `sys.exit()`. Silent loss of up to FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECS x event-rate
per shutdown, frequent on macOS where every install.sh upgrade triggers
a launchctl bootout/load cycle.
